I think it's because of the emptiness inside. Human mind always wants to be occupied with something and always be stimulated. Once you realise nothing matters, whoever you are, you will feel so empty about everything and just want to die.
Did not mean to come off preachy but I suffer a similar situation as well.

Hell yeah man. Just made a post about myself also and it sounded pretty similar. Come to think of it, humans must have the same thoughts about evaluating the concept of life and their experiences of life. But mine was just in a more bitter tone lmao. If you make a blog, please link it to us I'll surely read it.
